name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.PublicTail.literal_projection_horizon
title: Finite horizon for a separately emitted four-row garbling of all unrolled suffix tests
statement: At 4096 NAND gates per cofactor, three per binary OR and two for payload gating, a single literal four-row 129-bit-output garbling fits below 2^32 bits only if at most ten tail bits are eliminated.
